rule: every canvas the page draws is one monitor, and n is its number on the wall; the wall holds five blocks: 1 benefit and organism (twelve monitors, three rows of four on a laptop), 2 real runs on GitHub, 3 brain and mechanism, 4 clouds, chips, orchestrators and scale, 5 proof and telemetry; each block reads left to right, then the next row, under its own heading, and a native and Omni-Compass pair stays side by side; page_n is each monitor's order of appearance on the page; every monitor names its wiring: the page's own code, the Python it ports or reads, the C++ twin or why there is none, the checks that hold them equal, and how it moves; the registry lists the monitors in number order

kill.label: Kill Switch
kill.what: Omni-Compass ON (green) or engaged (red): every setting handed back to native at once; every Omni-Compass side follows native (white)
kill.where: the kill switch (section 1; its wiring, section 5g)

dial.label: Tune Dial
dial.what: the max (every muscle to its own limit) or the tune-down (never more than native)

load.label: Demand
load.what: ×0.25 to ×2 of the day's own demand, both arms alike

noise.label: Noise
noise.what: σ of the demand's noise, one draw a muscle a decision, both arms alike

lag.label: Sense Delay
lag.what: decisions added between what a muscle does and what its controller reads, both arms alike

faults.label: Faults
faults.what: a surge, half the machines lost, a sense blind, a security hold, on the chosen body part

step.label: One Decision
step.what: step the engine one decision while paused

frame.label: Frame Load
frame.what: +0, +8 or +16 ms burned inside every frame of this page

run.label: Run
run.what: A, B or C (or the archived run) the monitor plays

rep.label: Repetition
rep.what: which repetition of the run is replayed

arm.label: Arm
arm.what: which arm stands on the right: Omni-Compass governing, or watching only

stack.label: Stack
stack.what: the GPU card, the Linux host, Kubernetes or the cloud

governor.label: Governor
governor.what: which orchestrator or governor is shown

scenario.label: Scenario
scenario.what: on-site bare metal, through the cloud, in the device, as a service

reading.label: Reading
reading.what: every measured piece carried, or the index's strict rule

chip.label: Chip Run
chip.what: the chip's one run beside the count or in it

beat.label: Beat
beat.what: the governor's full read of the state and its decision: every 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 60, 75, 90 or 120 s in the heartbeat sweep's record; on a real governor its --interval (60 s at the factory since omni-v17, 15 s on omni-v16)

engine.label: Engine
engine.what: which engine's record the monitor reads: the engine that stands or the one before it

against.label: Baseline
against.what: what each reading is set against: native, or the same engine at another setting

gauge.label: Gauge
gauge.what: which gauge of the run is shown

filter.label: Filter
filter.what: which rows, words, families or organisms are shown

body.label: Body
body.what: which body the organism runs: the harness, the organism, every muscle alone

muscle.label: Muscle Switch
muscle.what: pick one muscle on either ring: its card, and its own switch, which hands that one muscle back to native (Omni-Compass OFF on it) or puts Omni-Compass on it again; the kill switch hands every muscle back at once
muscle.where: the organism's monitors and the muscle's card (section 3a)

runs.label: Runs
runs.what: how many of the Python's runs this page computes again

print.label: Print
print.what: the receipts of the runs, printable, with the digests and the notice

seed.label: Seed Base
seed.what: which held-out seed base's 500 scenarios are replayed

set.label: Set
set.what: the Python's own 500 (numpy, seed 223387268) or a set the jump generator drew on this page
set.where: the Monte Carlo monitor's set knob (section 5a)

way.label: Omni-Compass Way
way.what: the bounded command toward the nearest basin, toward the far basin, or with the double well off (μ = 0); native is the plant alone (u = 0)
way.where: the Monte Carlo monitor's way knob (section 5a)

play.label: Play / Pause
play.what: the cursor's sweep of the 20 macro steps, held or running

system.label: Custom System
system.what: your stack written as ranges of the core's six states and 22 parameters, run in the page or on GitHub through the Python and the C++ (systems/README.md)
system.where: the Monte Carlo monitor's own-system panel (section 5a)

monitors.cls: L (the official run's request log, SHA-256-checked)

feed.exporter: SLO recording rules (sloth, pyrra) over the service's histogram

wire.cpp_none: none: the live software's own measurements, played back from their SHA-256-checked files
wire.moves: half minute by half minute through the official run; its newest value printed at the head

monitors.name: Error Budget Burn
monitors.what: The requests over the 500 ms line counted up since the repetition began, native beside Omni-Compass: each side's error budget burned.
monitors.cls: L (the official run's request log, SHA-256-checked)

feed.exporter: SLO recording rules (sloth, pyrra)

wire.cpp_none: none: the live software's own measurements, played back from their SHA-256-checked files
wire.moves: half minute by half minute through the official run; its newest value printed at the head

monitors.name: Repetition Gauges Against Native
monitors.what: Every gauge of the repetition replaying in section 4a against native's 0 line: GAIN to the right in green, LOSS to the left in red, its side the run's own reading.

feed.exporter: the build (the repository's tables, no live feed: a recording rule would compose the layers' ratios)

wire.cpp_none: none: the live software's own measurements, played back from their SHA-256-checked files
wire.moves: each gauge of the repetition replaying in section 4a

monitors.name: GitHub Actions in Flight
monitors.what: Every workflow run in progress or queued when the page was built, the Azure set's repetitions done of its cap, and the clouds' gates.
monitors.cls: L (GitHub's own API, read at the build)

feed.exporter: GitHub Actions API (read at the build); live: github-actions-exporter

wire.cpp_none: none: GitHub's own record of its runs, read from its API at the build
wire.moves: the reading cursor walks the workflows, one a decision; the age of GitHub's reading counts up every second

monitors.name: System Response per Decision · Class S
monitors.what: The last 120 decisions of the live benchmark engine: the muscles past their line and the work, native beside Omni-Compass, every knob of the console turned marked.

feed.exporter: this page's own clock (no exporter: the page measures itself)

wire.moves: every decision: both lanes slide one decision, a ring opens at each head with its newest value; every knob turned is marked

monitors.name: Inter-Frame Interval
monitors.what: The time between frames of this page against its line under the frame load knob.

feed.exporter: this page's own clock (no exporter: the page measures itself)

wire.cpp_none: none: the page's own frame clock, measured in the browser; there is nothing to port
wire.moves: every frame of this page

monitors.name: Inter-Frame Interval by Window
monitors.what: This page's own render loop governed by the compass law: the frame time against its line, native (no governor) beside Omni-Compass.

feed.exporter: this page's own clock (no exporter: the page measures itself)

wire.moves: every frame: this page's own frame time under the compass law
